name: JAYT_TIER_STATE_MACHINE_EZ

CANDIDATE_INGESTED.description: Initial intake of candidate observation from read-only sweep.

QUARANTINED.description: Record failed integrity, contains forbidden claims, missing provenance, or was rejected by Council.

TIER_4_RADAR.description: Fail-closed default state: Neutral tracking link with canonical source URL and standard copy only.

TIER_3_PUBLIC_FACILITY.description: Public community schedule/facility with official authoritative proof.

TIER_2_OFFICIAL_PROGRAM.description: Official educational or public program terms proven by verbatim doc quote.

TIER_1_VERIFIED_OFFER.description: Verified economic offer with full 12-field evidence schema proven by raw receipt.

invariant_rules: Rule 1: If any economic field is null or unproven -> State MUST be TIER_4_RADAR or QUARANTINED.
Rule 2: No account-dependent or cart-dependent voucher can ever enter TIER_1_VERIFIED_OFFER.
Rule 3: TIER_1_VERIFIED_OFFER count is strictly 0 until independent CEO gate sign-off.
Rule 4: Affiliate links, sub-ids, and campaign deeplinks are permanently blocked in all states.
